note: The palette ships its own plain CSS (src/css/*.css, multiselect-style layers). Every --cp-* knob is declared on :host and reads the shared --base-* contract (@keenmate/base-css-variables 2.0) with an inline fallback, so a :root theme reaches it; set --cp-* on the element itself.
